title: Sevimli mashg‘ulotlar va bo‘sh vaqt
goal_uz: Dars oxirida bo‘sh vaqt va sevimli mashg‘ulotlar haqida so‘raysiz va javob berasiz, like, love va hate dan keyin ing shaklini to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz hamda uchta mashg‘ulotingiz haqida because bilan sabab keltirib gapirasiz.

scenes.title: Bo‘sh vaqtda nima qilasiz?
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘n yettinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda ob-havo va fasllar haqida gaplashdik. Bugun yangi tanishlar bilan eng ko‘p gaplashadigan mavzuni o‘rganamiz: sevimli mashg‘ulotlar va bo‘sh vaqt. Dars oxirida o‘zingizning uchta mashg‘ulotingiz va ularni nega yaxshi ko‘rishingiz haqida ingliz tilida gapira olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson seventeen! Last time we talked about the weather. Today we will talk about hobbies and free time.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n yettinchi darsga xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar ob-havo haqida gaplashdik. Bugun sevimli mashg‘ulotlar va bo‘sh vaqt haqida gaplashamiz.

scenes.title: Sport va faol mashg‘ulotlar
scenes.say_native: Boshlaymiz hobbi so‘zlaridan. Sport va faol mashg‘ulotlar: “play football” — futbol o‘ynash, “play chess” — shaxmat o‘ynash, “swim” — suzish, “run” — yugurish, “dance” — raqsga tushish, “ride a bike” — velosiped haydash. Bu yerda “hobby” so‘zi ham bor: “hobby” — sevimli mashg‘ulot. Uning ko‘pligi “hobbies”, “y” harfi “ies” ga almashadi.
scenes.say: Play football. Play chess. Swim. Run. Dance. Ride a bike. A hobby, two hobbies.
scenes.say_uz: Futbol o‘ynash. Shaxmat o‘ynash. Suzish. Yugurish. Raqs tushish. Velosiped haydash. Bitta hobbi, ikkita hobbi.

scenes.title: Uyda va dam olishda
scenes.say_native: Endi tinch mashg‘ulotlar. “Read books” — kitob o‘qish. “Watch films” yoki “watch TV” — film yoki televizor ko‘rish. “Listen to music” — musiqa tinglash. “Cook” — ovqat tayyorlash, “draw” — rasm chizish, “take photos” — rasmga olish. Bu so‘zlarning hammasi fe’l, ya’ni harakat. Shu sabab ular bilan hobbi haqida gapirish oson.
scenes.say: Read books. Watch films. Listen to music. Cook. Draw. Take photos.
scenes.say_uz: Kitob o‘qish. Film ko‘rish. Musiqa tinglash. Ovqat tayyorlash. Rasm chizish. Rasmga olish.

scenes.title: Qaysi fe’l qaysi so‘z bilan

examples.t: I listen to music every day.

scenes.say_native: Inglizchada har bir so‘z o‘ziga xos fe’l bilan keladi. Sport va o‘yin bilan “play”. Musiqa bilan “listen”, lekin albatta “to” bilan. O‘zbekchada “musiqa tinglash” deymiz, “ga” shart emas, inglizchada esa “listen to”. Ko‘rish uchun “watch”, “look” emas. Cholg‘u asboblarida britaniyaliklar “the” ishlatadi: “play the guitar”, sportda esa “the” yo‘q: “play football”.
scenes.say: Play football, but play the guitar. Listen to music. Watch TV. We always need to after listen.
scenes.say_uz: Play football, lekin play the guitar. Listen to music. Watch TV. Listen dan keyin to albatta kerak.

scenes.title: Tez-tez uchraydigan xatolar
board: ✓ I listen to music. I play football. I watch TV.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “I listen music”, chunki o‘zbekchada “ga” ni qo‘shmaymiz. To‘g‘risi “listen to music”. Ikkinchisi: “play the football”, futbolda “the” ishlatilmaydi, to‘g‘risi “play football”. Uchinchisi: “look TV”. “Look” — qaramoq, “watch” esa harakatni kuzatib ko‘rish, shuning uchun televizor uchun faqat “watch TV”. Bu xatolarni o‘zingiz ham bir marta baland ovozda aytib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Not: I listen music. Say: I listen to music. Not: I play the football. Say: I play football. Not: I look TV. Say: I watch TV.
scenes.say_uz: I listen music emas. I listen to music deng. I play the football emas. I play football deng. I look TV emas. I watch TV deng.

scenes.title: Fe’lni tanlang
scenes.say_native: Bo‘sh joylarga mos fe’lni qo‘ying. Play, listen to yoki watch ichidan tanlang. Birinchi: futbol. Ikkinchi: musiqa. Uchinchi: televizor. To‘rtinchi: shaxmat. Har bir iborani to‘liq ayting, masalan “I ... football”. Ikkinchi iborada “to” ni unutmang.
scenes.say: Choose the verb. One: football. Two: music. Three: TV. Four: chess.
scenes.say_uz: Fe’lni tanlang. Bir: futbol. Ikki: musiqa. Uch: televizor. To‘rt: shaxmat.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Futbol bilan “play”: “play football”. Musiqa bilan “listen to”: “listen to music”. Televizor bilan “watch”: “watch TV”. Shaxmat bilan ham “play”: “play chess”. Agar “listen to” ni “to” bilan aytgan bo‘lsangiz, o‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilarning eng ko‘p xatosidan qutuldingiz. Ana shunday, har bir fe’lning o‘z sherigi bor.
scenes.say: Play football. Listen to music. Watch TV. Play chess.
scenes.say_uz: Futbol o‘ynash. Musiqa tinglash. Televizor ko‘rish. Shaxmat o‘ynash.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: hobby, guitar, favourite
scenes.say_native: Bir nechta so‘zni to‘g‘ri aytishni o‘rganamiz. “Hobby” so‘zida urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: “xob-i”, “h” yengil nafas bilan. “Guitar” da urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: “gi-TAA”. “Favourite” uch bo‘g‘inli yozilsa ham, ko‘pincha ikki bo‘g‘inli aytiladi: “FEY-vrit”. “Chess” so‘zidagi “ch” o‘zbekchadagi “ch” ga o‘xshaydi. Amerika yozuvi “favorite”, “u” siz.
scenes.say: Hobby. Guitar, with the stress on tar. Favourite. Chess. American spelling: favorite.
scenes.say_uz: Hobby. Guitar, urg‘u tar da. Favourite. Chess. Amerikacha yozilishi: favorite.

scenes.title: Like, love, hate
scenes.say_native: Mashg‘ulotga munosabatni to‘rtta so‘z bilan aytamiz. “Love” — juda yaxshi ko‘raman, “like” — yoqadi, “don't like” — yoqmaydi, “hate” — yomon ko‘raman. Ular kuchidan zaiflashgan shkala hosil qiladi. “Hate” juda kuchli, shuning uchun muloyim vaziyatda “I don't like” ko‘proq ishlatiladi. O‘zbekchada “menga yoqadi” deymiz, inglizchada esa “I like”, ya’ni “men yoqtiraman”.
scenes.say: Love, like, don't like, hate. I love swimming. I like reading. I don't like running. I hate cooking.
scenes.say_uz: Juda yaxshi ko‘rish, yoqtirish, yoqtirmaslik, yomon ko‘rish. Suzishni yaxshi ko‘raman. Kitob o‘qish yoqadi. Yugurish yoqmaydi. Ovqat pishirishni yomon ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Like va -ing shakli
scenes.say_native: Endi eng muhim qoida. Like, love va hate dan keyin fe’lga “ing” qo‘shamiz: “I like swimming”. O‘zbekchada “suzishni yaxshi ko‘raman” deymiz, ya’ni “ish” qo‘shimchasi bor, inglizchada uning o‘rni “ing”. Rus tilida esa “люблю плавать”, ya’ni to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri fe’l, shuning uchun ruscha o‘ylaydiganlar “I like swim” deb xato qiladi. Inglizchada “I like to swim” ham to‘g‘ri, ma’nosi deyarli bir xil, lekin bugun “ing” ni mashq qilamiz.
scenes.say: After like, love and hate, add ing. I like swimming. She loves dancing. I like to swim is also correct.
scenes.say_uz: Like, love va hate dan keyin ing qo‘shing. I like swimming. She loves dancing. I like to swim ham to‘g‘ri.

scenes.title: Ing qo‘shish qoidalari
scenes.say_native: Imlo bo‘yicha uchta holat bor. Birinchi, ko‘pchilik fe’l: shunchaki “ing”, “read, reading”, “cook, cooking”, “play, playing”. Ikkinchi, “e” bilan tugasa, “e” tushib qoladi: “dance, dancing”. Uchinchi, bir bo‘g‘inli qisqa fe’llarda oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: “swim, swimming”, “run, running”. Bu uchinchi qoida eng ko‘p xato qilinadigan joy, shuning uchun uni yaxshi eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Read, reading. Dance, dancing. Swim, swimming. Run, running.
scenes.say_uz: Read, reading. Dance, dancing. Swim, swimming. Run, running.

scenes.title: Like swim emas
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato: “I like swim”. Fe’l “like” dan keyin o‘z holicha qolmaydi. Yo “ing” qo‘shing: “I like swimming”, yo “to” qo‘shing: “I like to swim”. Ikkala usulni aralashtirmang: “I like to swimming” noto‘g‘ri. Bir narsani yodda tuting, “to” va “ing” hech qachon birga kelmaydi. Ikkinchi xato: imlo, “runing” emas, “running”.
scenes.say: Not: I like swim. Say: I like swimming. Or: I like to swim. Do not mix to and ing.
scenes.say_uz: I like swim emas. I like swimming deng. Yoki I like to swim. To va ing ni aralashtirmang.

scenes.title: Fe’lni to‘g‘rilang
scenes.say_native: Qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklga qo‘ying. Birinchi: men suzishni yoqtiraman. Ikkinchi: u raqsga tushishni yaxshi ko‘radi. Uchinchi: ular yugurishni yomon ko‘rishadi. To‘rtinchi: u ovqat pishirishni yoqtiradi. Imloga e’tibor bering: qaysi fe’lda harf ikkilanadi, qaysida “e” tushadi? Uchinchi shaxsda esa “like” ga “s” qo‘shiladi.
scenes.say: Put the verb in the right form. One: I like swim. Two: she loves dance. Three: they hate run. Four: he likes cook.
scenes.say_uz: Fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklga qo‘ying. Bir: I like swim. Ikki: she loves dance. Uch: they hate run. To‘rt: he likes cook.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I like swimming”, “m” ikkilanadi. Ikkinchi: “She loves dancing”, “dance” dagi “e” tushadi. Uchinchi: “They hate running”, “n” ikkilanadi. To‘rtinchi: “He likes cooking”, bu yerda “like” ga “s” qo‘shilgan, chunki “he” bilan. Uchinchi shaxsda fe’lning oxiriga “s” kerak, bu qoida oldingi darslardan sizga tanish.
scenes.say: I like swimming. She loves dancing. They hate running. He likes cooking.
scenes.say_uz: Menga suzish yoqadi. U raqsni yaxshi ko‘radi. Ular yugurishni yomon ko‘rishadi. Unga ovqat pishirish yoqadi.

scenes.title: Savol va qisqa javob
board: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
scenes.say_native: Endi savol. “Do you like swimming?”, ya’ni suzish yoqadimi? Javob qisqa: “Yes, I do” yoki “No, I don't”. “Like” ni javobda takrorlamaymiz. Boshqa odam haqida so‘ralsa, “do” o‘rniga “does” ishlatiladi: “Does she like dancing?”, va javob “Yes, she does”. Diqqat qiling, “does” dan keyin “like” ga “s” kerak emas, chunki “s” allaqachon “does” da bor.
scenes.say: Do you like swimming? Yes, I do. No, I don't. Does she like dancing? Yes, she does.
scenes.say_uz: Suzish yoqadimi? Ha. Yo‘q. U raqsni yoqtiradimi? Ha.

scenes.title: Bo‘sh vaqt haqida so‘rash
board: What do you do in your free time?

examples.t: What do you do in your free time?
I read books and watch films.
examples.uz: Men kitob o‘qiyman va film ko‘raman.

scenes.say_native: Bo‘sh vaqt haqida so‘rashning asosiy usuli: “What do you do in your free time?” Javobda oddiy fe’llarni sanaysiz: “I read books and I watch films”. Ikkinchi usul: “What's your hobby?” yoki ko‘plikda “What are your hobbies?”. Javob: “My hobby is reading” yoki “My hobbies are reading and swimming”. “Free time” sanalmaydi, shuning uchun “a free time” demaymiz.
scenes.say: What do you do in your free time? I read books. What are your hobbies? My hobby is reading.
scenes.say_uz: Bo‘sh vaqtingizda nima qilasiz? Men kitob o‘qiyman. Sevimli mashg‘ulotlaringiz qanday? Mening mashg‘ulotim kitob o‘qish.

scenes.title: Savolda xato
board: ✗ What you do in free time?
✓ What do you do in your free time?
scenes.say_native: Savolda ko‘p uchraydigan uchta xato. Birinchi: “do” ni tushirib qoldirish, “What you do”. Savolda “do” albatta kerak. Ikkinchi: “What do you doing”, “do” dan keyin fe’l oddiy shaklda turadi: “do”. Uchinchi: “My hobby is read”. “Is” dan keyin “reading”, ya’ni “ing” kerak. Va oxirida “your” ni ham unutmang: odatda “in your free time” deyiladi.
scenes.say: Remember do in the question. What do you do in your free time? Not: what do you doing. My hobby is reading.
scenes.say_uz: Savolda do ni unutmang. What do you do in your free time? What do you doing emas. My hobby is reading.

scenes.title: Qachon: weekend va kunlar

examples.t: I usually read at the weekend.
examples.uz: Men odatda dam olish kunlari o‘qiyman.

scenes.say_native: Mashg‘ulot qachon bo‘lishini ham aytish mumkin. Hafta kuni bilan “on”: “on Saturdays” — shanba kunlari. Dam olish kunlari uchun britaniyalik “at the weekend” deydi, amerikalik esa “on the weekend”. “Every day” — har kuni, “after school” — maktabdan keyin. “Usually” — odatda, “sometimes” — ba’zan. Bu so‘zlar fe’ldan oldin turadi: “I usually read”.
scenes.say: On Saturdays. At the weekend. Every day. I usually read at the weekend. I sometimes watch films.
scenes.say_uz: Shanba kunlari. Dam olish kunlari. Har kuni. Men odatda dam olish kunlari o‘qiyman. Ba’zan film ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Savol bering
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaziyat. Yangi tanishingizdan bo‘sh vaqtida nima qilishini so‘rang. Ikkinchi, sevimli mashg‘ulotlarini so‘rang. Uchinchi, unga suzish yoqadimi, so‘rang. Savollarni baland ovozda to‘liq ayting. Birinchi savolda “do” va “free time” ni, uchinchisida “like” va “ing” ni unutmang.
scenes.say: Ask three questions. One: ask about free time. Two: ask about hobbies. Three: ask about swimming.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol bering. Bir: bo‘sh vaqt haqida. Ikki: mashg‘ulotlar haqida. Uch: suzish haqida.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) What do you do in your free time?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “What do you do in your free time?”. Ikkinchi: “What are your hobbies?” yoki “What's your hobby?”. Uchinchi: “Do you like swimming?”. Ularning har birini to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, siz bu tilda suhbatni boshlashingiz mumkin. Savol berish suhbatning yarmi, chunki odamlar o‘zlari haqida gapirishni yaxshi ko‘radi.
scenes.say: What do you do in your free time? What are your hobbies? Do you like swimming?
scenes.say_uz: Bo‘sh vaqtingizda nima qilasiz? Mashg‘ulotlaringiz qanday? Suzish yoqadimi?

scenes.title: Maktabda suhbat
board: Tom: What do you do in your free time, Lola?
Lola: I like reading and I love drawing.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog: maktabda ikki sinfdosh, Tom va Lola, bo‘sh vaqt haqida gaplashmoqda. Diqqat bilan tinglang. Lola nimani yaxshi ko‘radi? Tom futbolni qachon o‘ynaydi? Tomga suzish yoqadimi? Birinchi tinglaganda hamma narsani tushunmasangiz ham xafa bo‘lmang, savollar dialogdan keyin keladi.
scenes.say: Tom: What do you do in your free time, Lola? Lola: I like reading and I love drawing. What about you? Tom: I play football on Saturdays. Do you like swimming? Lola: Yes, I do. Do you? Tom: No, I don't. I hate it!
scenes.say_uz: Tom: Bo‘sh vaqtingizda nima qilasiz, Lola? Lola: Menga kitob o‘qish yoqadi va rasm chizishni yaxshi ko‘raman. Sen-chi? Tom: Men shanba kunlari futbol o‘ynayman. Suzish yoqadimi? Lola: Ha. Senga-chi? Tom: Yo‘q. Yomon ko‘raman!

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Dialogni eslab, savollarga javob bering. Birinchi: Lola nimani yaxshi ko‘radi? Ikkinchi: Tom futbolni qachon o‘ynaydi? Uchinchi: Tomga suzish yoqadimi? Uchinchi savolda qisqa javob bering. Javobni dialogdagi gap bilan ayting va to‘liq gap bo‘lishiga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: One: what does Lola love? Two: when does Tom play football? Three: does Tom like swimming?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Lola nimani yaxshi ko‘radi? Ikki: Tom futbolni qachon o‘ynaydi? Uch: Tomga suzish yoqadimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Lola rasm chizishni yaxshi ko‘radi: “She loves drawing”. Tom futbolni shanba kunlari o‘ynaydi: “On Saturdays”. Tomga suzish yoqmaydi: “No, he doesn't”, uchinchi shaxsda “doesn't” ishlatamiz. Dialogda Tom “I hate it” dedi, ya’ni suzishni yomon ko‘radi. Bunda “it” suzishni bildiradi, shuning uchun “swimming” ni takrorlash shart emas.
scenes.say: She loves drawing. On Saturdays. No, he doesn't. He hates it.
scenes.say_uz: U rasm chizishni yaxshi ko‘radi. Shanba kunlari. Yo‘q. U yomon ko‘radi.

scenes.title: Because: sabab
board: I like swimming because it's fun.

examples.t: I like reading because it's relaxing.
examples.uz: Kitob o‘qish menga yoqadi, chunki u dam beradi.

examples.t: Why do you like football? Because it's exciting.

scenes.say_native: Sababni “because” bilan aytamiz, o‘zbekchada “chunki”. Savol: “Why do you like swimming?”, ya’ni nega suzish yoqadi? Javob: “Because it's fun”. “Because” dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi: ega va fe’l. Yozuvda “because” ni gap o‘rtasiga qo‘yamiz: “I like swimming because it's fun”. Qisqa javobda esa gapning boshida ham bo‘lishi mumkin: “Because it's fun”.
scenes.say: I like swimming because it's fun. Why do you like it? Because it's relaxing.
scenes.say_uz: Menga suzish yoqadi, chunki u qiziqarli. Nega yoqadi? Chunki u dam beradi.

scenes.title: Sabab uchun sifatlar
scenes.say_native: Sababni aytish uchun sifatlar kerak. “Fun” — qiziqarli, o‘yin-kulgi. “Exciting” — hayajonli. “Relaxing” — dam beruvchi, tinchlantiruvchi. “Interesting” — qiziq, “boring” — zerikarli. “Easy” — oson, “difficult” — qiyin. “Healthy” ham foydali sifat, ya’ni sog‘liq uchun yaxshi. Eslatma: “fun” so‘zi “it is fun” iborasida tayyor qolip sifatida ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Fun, exciting, relaxing, interesting, boring, easy, difficult, healthy.
scenes.say_uz: Qiziqarli, hayajonli, dam beruvchi, qiziq, zerikarli, oson, qiyin, foydali.

scenes.title: Because dan keyin ega
board: ✗ I like football because is fun.
✓ I like football because it's fun.
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda ham ega masalasi chiqdi. “Because fun” noto‘g‘ri, chunki “because” dan keyin to‘liq gap kerak. “Because is fun” ham noto‘g‘ri, chunki “is” ning egasi yo‘q. O‘zbekchada “chunki qiziqarli” deymiz va ega yo‘q, inglizchada esa “it” ni qo‘yishimiz kerak: “because it's fun”. Boshqa odam haqida bo‘lsa: “because she's good at it”, ya’ni “u buni yaxshi uddalaydi”, lekin bu iborani keyinroq o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Remember it after because. I like football because it's fun. Not: because fun.
scenes.say_uz: because dan keyin it ni unutmang. I like football because it's fun. Because fun emas.

scenes.title: Sababni qo‘shing
scenes.say_native: Gapni sabab bilan davom ettiring. Birinchi: menga shaxmat yoqadi, chunki u qiziq. Ikkinchi: yugurishni yomon ko‘raman, chunki zerikarli. Uchinchi: ovqat pishirishni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki dam beradi. Har birini “because it's” bilan davom ettiring. Gapni boshidan oxirigacha ayting.
scenes.say: Add a reason. One: I like chess, interesting. Two: I hate running, boring. Three: I love cooking, relaxing.
scenes.say_uz: Sabab qo‘shing. Bir: shaxmat yoqadi, qiziq. Ikki: yugurishni yomon ko‘raman, zerikarli. Uch: ovqat pishirish yoqadi, dam beradi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I like chess because it's interesting.
2) I hate running because it's boring.
3) I love cooking because it's relaxing.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “I like chess because it's interesting.” “I hate running because it's boring.” “I love cooking because it's relaxing.” Uchala gapda ham bir xil naqsh bor: fikr, “because”, “it's”, sifat. Bu naqshni bilsangiz, har qanday mashg‘ulotni izohlay olasiz. Faqat sifatni almashtirasiz xolos.
scenes.say: I like chess because it's interesting. I hate running because it's boring. I love cooking because it's relaxing.
scenes.say_uz: Shaxmat menga yoqadi, chunki u qiziq. Yugurishni yomon ko‘raman, chunki u zerikarli. Ovqat pishirishni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki u dam beradi.

scenes.title: Klubda suhbat
board: Ben: Do you like sports, Aziz?
Aziz: I love football because it's exciting.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: sport klubida Ben Azizdan mashg‘ulotlari haqida so‘rayapti. Tinglang va ushlang: Aziz nimani yaxshi ko‘radi va nega? Unga ovqat pishirish yoqadimi? Nima uchun? Bu dialogda “Why” savoli ham, “because” bilan javob ham bor, shuning uchun yangi o‘rganganlaringizni diqqat bilan kuzating.
scenes.say: Ben: Do you like sports, Aziz? Aziz: Yes, I love football because it's exciting. Ben: Do you like cooking? Aziz: No, I don't. It's difficult. Ben: Why do you like football? Aziz: Because it's fun with friends.
scenes.say_uz: Ben: Aziz, sen sportni yoqtirasanmi? Aziz: Ha, futbolni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki hayajonli. Ben: Ovqat pishirish yoqadimi? Aziz: Yo‘q. Qiyin. Ben: Nega futbol yoqadi? Aziz: Chunki do‘stlar bilan qiziq.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar. Birinchi: Aziz nega futbolni yaxshi ko‘radi? Ikkinchi: unga ovqat pishirish yoqadimi? Uchinchi: nega yo‘q? Javobda “because” ni ishlatishga harakat qiling. Esda tuting, Aziz futbol haqida ikki sabab aytdi. Ikkalasini ham ayting.
scenes.say: One: why does Aziz love football? Two: does he like cooking? Three: why not?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Aziz nega futbolni yaxshi ko‘radi? Ikki: ovqat pishirish yoqadimi? Uch: nega yo‘q?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Because it's exciting. / It's fun with friends.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: futbol hayajonli va do‘stlar bilan qiziq, “because it's exciting”. Ikkinchi: yo‘q, unga ovqat pishirish yoqmaydi, “No, he doesn't”. Uchinchi: chunki u qiyin, “because it's difficult”. Ko‘rib turibsiz, Aziz ham yoqtirmaslikni muloyim sabab bilan tushuntirdi. Bu tilning odobli usuli, “hate” demasdan, “it's difficult” deyish.
scenes.say: Because it's exciting and fun with friends. No, he doesn't. Because it's difficult.
scenes.say_uz: Chunki hayajonli va do‘stlar bilan qiziq. Yo‘q. Chunki qiyin.

scenes.title: Tabiiy talaffuz: Do you
scenes.say_native: Suhbatda inglizlar so‘zlarni tez va birlashtirib aytadi. “Do you” ko‘pincha “d'you” bo‘lib eshitiladi, “dj” ga o‘xshab: “d'you like music?”. “Do” yengillashadi, “you” esa “yə” bo‘ladi. Shuning uchun filmlarda “Do you like” ni tushunmay qolish mumkin. “Because” so‘zida urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: “bi-KOZ”, tezda esa ko‘pincha “'cause” deyiladi.
scenes.say: Do you like music? It often sounds like d'you like music. Because: bi-KOZ.
scenes.say_uz: Do you like music? Ko‘pincha d'you like music kabi eshitiladi. Because: bi-KOZ.

scenes.title: Tez va tabiiy ayting
scenes.say_native: Endi uchta gapni tez va tabiiy ayting. “Do you” ni birlashtirib, “d'you” deb ayting. “Why do you like it” gapida “why” ga urg‘u bering, “do you” ni yengil o‘tkazing. Javobda esa “because” ni “koz” kabi qisqartirishga urinib ko‘ring. Uch marta takrorlang.
scenes.say: Do you like swimming? Why do you like it? Because it's fun.
scenes.say_uz: Suzish yoqadimi? Nega yoqadi? Chunki qiziqarli.

scenes.title: Tekshiramiz
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi! Bu usulda gapirsangiz, nutqingiz tabiiyroq bo‘ladi. Eslab qoling: ingliz tilida kichik so‘zlar yengil, asosiy so‘zlar kuchli. “Do you” yengil, “like” va “swimming” kuchli. Savolda “why” ga urg‘u tushadi, javobda esa “fun” kabi sifatga. Agar ilk urinishda tez aytolmasangiz, avval sekin ayting, keyin asta-sekin tezlashtiring.
scenes.say: Good. Say do you quickly and lightly. Stress why, like and fun.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi. Do you ni tez va yengil ayting. Why, like va fun ga urg‘u bering.

scenes.title: Ing shakli ega sifatida
scenes.say_native: Ing shakli faqat like dan keyin emas, otga o‘xshab ham ishlatiladi. “Swimming is fun” — suzish qiziqarli. “Reading is relaxing” — kitob o‘qish dam beradi. Bunda ing shakli gapning egasi. O‘zbekchada ham “suzish qiziqarli” deymiz, ya’ni “ish” qo‘shimchali so‘z ega bo‘ladi, shuning uchun bu sizga qiyin emas. Hobbi haqida gapirganda “My hobby is cooking” deyish ham juda tabiiy.
scenes.say: Swimming is fun. Reading is relaxing. My hobby is cooking. We can use the ing form as the subject.
scenes.say_uz: Suzish qiziqarli. Kitob o‘qish dam beradi. Mening mashg‘ulotim ovqat pishirish. Ing shaklini ega sifatida ishlatsak bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Ha yoki yo‘q
scenes.say_native: Jadvalga qarang. Tomga futbol yoqadi, suzish yoqmaydi. Lolaga rasm chizish ham, suzish ham yoqadi. Uchta savolga qisqa javob bering. Birinchi: Tomga futbol yoqadimi? Ikkinchi: Lolaga suzish yoqadimi? Uchinchi: Tomga suzish yoqadimi? Javobda “Yes, she does” yoki “No, he doesn't” deb ayting va “he” yoki “she” ni to‘g‘ri tanlang.
scenes.say: Look at the table. Tom likes football, but not swimming. Lola likes drawing and swimming. One: does Tom like football? Two: does Lola like swimming? Three: does Tom like swimming?
scenes.say_uz: Jadvalga qarang. Tomga futbol yoqadi, suzish yoqmaydi. Lolaga rasm chizish va suzish yoqadi. Bir: Tomga futbol yoqadimi? Ikki: Lolaga suzish yoqadimi? Uch: Tomga suzish yoqadimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Tomga futbol yoqadi: “Yes, he does”. Lolaga suzish yoqadi: “Yes, she does”. Tomga suzish yoqmaydi: “No, he doesn't”. Erkak uchun “he”, ayol uchun “she”, ikkalasida ham “does” yoki “doesn't”, “do” emas. Agar bu yerda “do” desangiz, bu eng keng tarqalgan xato, uni oldingi savollardagi “you” bilan adashtirish bilan bog‘liq.
scenes.say: Yes, he does. Yes, she does. No, he doesn't.
scenes.say_uz: Ha. Ha. Yo‘q.

scenes.title: Namuna: uchta hobbi
board: I love reading because it's relaxing.
I like swimming because it's healthy.
I don't like cooking because it's difficult.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa uchun namuna: “My hobbies are reading, swimming and drawing. I love reading because it's relaxing. I like swimming because it's healthy. I also like drawing because it's fun.” Ko‘rib turibsiz, avval hobbilarni sanadik, so‘ng har biriga bitta sabab qo‘shdik. Siz ham xuddi shunday: uchta mashg‘ulot va ularning har biri uchun “because it's”.
scenes.say: My hobbies are reading, swimming and drawing. I love reading because it's relaxing. I like swimming because it's healthy. I like drawing because it's fun.
scenes.say_uz: Mening mashg‘ulotlarim: kitob o‘qish, suzish va rasm chizish. Kitob o‘qishni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki u dam beradi. Suzish yoqadi, chunki foydali. Rasm chizish yoqadi, chunki qiziqarli.

scenes.title: Sizning navbatingiz
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘z uchta mashg‘ulotingiz haqida ayting. Avval “My hobbies are” deb hammasini sanang, so‘ng har biri uchun “I like” va “-ing” shaklini, “because it's” va sifatni ishlating. Shoshilmang, har gapni to‘liq tuzing. Eng muhimi, “like” dan keyin “ing” va “because” dan keyin “it's” bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Now it is your turn. Tell me your three hobbies. Say why you like each one. Use because it's and an adjective.
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Uchta mashg‘ulotingizni ayting. Har birini nega yoqtirishingizni ayting. Because it's va sifat ishlating.

scenes.title: Tekshirish ro‘yxati

examples.t: I love swimming because it's healthy.

scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tekshiring. Birinchidan, “like”, “love”, “hate” dan keyin “ing” qo‘shdingizmi? Ikkinchidan, “because” dan keyin “it's” va sifat ishlatdingizmi? Uchinchidan, savolga “Yes, I do” yoki “No, I don't” deb javob berdingizmi? To‘rtinchidan, “listen” dan keyin “to” qo‘ydingizmi? Hammasi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, siz ingliz tilida o‘zingiz haqingizda yaxshi gapira olasiz.
scenes.say: Check yourself. Did you use ing after like? Did you say because it's? Did you say listen to?
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingizni tekshiring. Like dan keyin ing ishlatdingizmi? Because it's dedingizmi? Listen to dedingizmi?

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: What do you do in your free time?
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz. Birinchi, mashg‘ulot fe’llari: “play football”, “listen to music”, “watch TV”. Ikkinchi, yoqtirish: “like”, “love”, “hate” va fe’l “ing” shaklida. Uchinchi, savol: “What do you do in your free time?” va “Do you like swimming?”. To‘rtinchi, sabab: “because it's fun”. Bu to‘rt narsa bilan har qanday yangi tanish bilan suhbat qura olasiz.
scenes.say: Today we learned hobby verbs, like plus ing, questions about free time and because it's.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun mashg‘ulot fe’llari, like va ing, bo‘sh vaqt haqidagi savollar va because it's ni o‘rgandik.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: and say why you like them
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: uchta sevimli mashg‘ulotingizni tasvirlang va nega ularni yoqtirishingizni ayting. Kamida uchta gap yozing yoki ovoz chiqarib ayting. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir gapda “like”, “love” yoki “hate” dan keyin “ing” bo‘lsin, har biri uchun “because it's” va sifat bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda “can” va “can't” bilan nimalarni qila olish va qila olmasligingizni aytishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: describe three hobbies and say why you like them. Write at least three sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: uchta mashg‘ulotni tasvirlang va nega yoqtirishingizni ayting. Kamida uchta gap yozing.

homework_uz: Uchta sevimli mashg‘ulotingizni tasvirlang va nega yoqtirishingizni ayting: kamida uchta gap yozing yoki ayting. Har bir gapda like, love yoki hate dan keyin ing bo‘lsin va har biri uchun because it's va sifat ishlating.

quiz.why_uz: Like dan keyin fe’lga ing qo‘shiladi: I like reading.
Listen fe’li to predlogi bilan keladi.
Sport va o‘yin bilan play ishlatiladi.
Like dan keyin swimming yoki to swim, aralashtirib bo‘lmaydi.
Qisqa bir bo‘g‘inli fe’lda oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi.

quiz.q: ___ you like cooking? No, I don't.

options: I like chess because it's interesting.
I like chess because is interesting.
I like chess because it interesting.
quiz.why_uz: Because dan keyin ega (it) va fe’l kerak.

quiz.q: What do you do in your ___ time?
quiz.why_uz: In your free time: free sifat, your bilan keladi.

quiz.q: Does he like swimming? No, he ___.
quiz.why_uz: He bilan qisqa javobda doesn't ishlatiladi.
